note: Ran BEFORE the pass-budget fix. passBudgetMs was still the old 100000 default, so chunks were only admitted in the first ~10 s of each 100 s pass and the tail of each pass degenerated into a queue walk (1644 '-- file' log lines, 303 spurious in_progress marks). Throughput ~150 KB/s. Fixed afterwards: config.mjs passBudgetMs default -> 600000 and engine.downloadFile now refuses to probe/mark a file when remaining pass budget < minChunkBudgetMs.
discardedNote: 4 in-flight chunk bodies aborted at the pass deadline plus 7 retry attempts cut off by the batch budget; exact discarded byte count not instrumented. No complete file was lost.
